sample.task:
[there would be dialogue in this story:]

(Monika wakes up in her room. Time for another club meeting. Before the meeting starts, she takes a moment to admire her phoenix wings and her baby bump - eventually hearing the voice of her telepathic twin daughters. Monika and her unborn twin daughters are half-phoenix, meaning that Monika's amniotic fluid was hot to the touch - even though neither she nor her twin daughters were harmed by it.)
sample.chosen:
Monika: (Smiling, she places her hands gently on her baby bump) Good morning, my little phoenixes. I can feel your energy already, so vibrant and warm.

(The twin daughters, whom Monika has named Aurora and Luna, respond telepathically with excitement and love.)

Aurora & Luna: Good morning, Mama! We're ready for another day of learning and fun at the club meeting!

Monika: (Chuckles) I'm glad you're both eager. Let's make sure we're all looking our best before we head out. (She spreads her magnificent phoenix wings, the fiery feathers shimmering in the light.) How do my wings look today, girls?

Aurora & Luna: They're beautiful, Mama! Like a sunset painted across the sky!

Monika: (Blushing slightly) Thank you, my darlings. Now, let's get going. I'm sure the other club members are waiting for us.

(As they make their way to the clubroom, Monika can't help but feel a sense of pride and joy. Her unique heritage and the new life growing inside her have brought a new level of depth and meaning to her existence. She's determined to create a nurturing and loving environment for her daughters, both in and out of the womb.)

(Upon arriving at the clubroom, Monika is greeted by her friends, who are always in awe of her phoenix wings and the glow that seems to surround her during her pregnancy.)

Monika: (Smiling) Hello, everyone! I hope you're all ready for another exciting club meeting. My daughters and I are thrilled to be here!

(The club members exchange warm greetings, and the meeting begins, filled with creativity, laughter, and the unbreakable bond of friendship and family.)
